summary: The netif cases of one card on the e1000: the interface ioctls, and a machine configured from nothing

cases.behavior: netifprobe passes each row at the debug shell of a machine with QEMU's address on the e1000: the interface ioctls, a change of address that aborts the connections open across it, the interface taken down, which drops the datagram the host sends, and brought up, which receives the next, and the routes

steps.does: boot the test image to the debug shell

run netifprobe at the debug shell, send it a datagram from the host with hostpeer send through the forward when it prints NETIFPROBE DOWN and again when it prints NETIFPROBE UP, and take its report from the console

assertions.checks: the raw descriptor that BusyBox's DHCP client asks the interface through, AF_INET, SOCK_RAW and IPPROTO_RAW, opens
a raw socket for TCP, a protocol the stack does not carry, answers EPROTONOSUPPORT
eth0 has index 1, and SIOCGIFINDEX of eth9 answers ENODEV
SIOCGIFNAME of index 1 gives eth0, and of index 7 answers ENODEV
SIOCGIFHWADDR of eth0 gives an Ethernet address that is not all zeros
SIOCGIFADDR of eth0 reads its address
the address is 10.0.2.15, the one QEMU's user network gives
the netmask reads back as 255.255.255.0
the broadcast address is the subnet's, 10.0.2.255
the MTU is 1500
the flags have IFF_UP or IFF_BROADCAST, IFF_MULTICAST and IFF_RUNNING
the query descriptor refuses bind, connect, listen, read and write with EOPNOTSUPP, and a poll of it reports POLLERR at once
a TCP connection to the machine's own 10.0.2.15 at port 7400 opens and is accepted, to be held across the change of address
a child at uid 1000 that sets the address is answered EPERM
the address 192.168.90.20 and the mask 255.255.255.0 are set, and the address reads back
after the change a write to one end of the held connection and a read of the other answer ENETRESET, and SO_ERROR then reads 0
the listener accepts a second connection, to the new address
the same address and mask set again leave the second connection's SO_ERROR 0
the address 172.16.1.2 set alone takes the classful mask 255.255.0.0
that later change leaves the first connection's SO_ERROR 0, and 192.168.90.20/24 is set again
with 10.0.2.15/24 set again the gateway answers a ping, and a datagram socket binds port 9999
eth0 taken down with SIOCSIFFLAGS reads neither IFF_UP nor IFF_RUNNING
the gateway does not answer a ping while eth0 is down
the datagram the host sends after NETIFPROBE DOWN raises eth0's receive drops in /proc/net/dev within 30 seconds, and the socket receives nothing
with eth0 brought back up the gateway answers a ping
a nonblocking read of the second connection, open across the change back to 10.0.2.15, answers ENETRESET
the datagram the host sends after NETIFPROBE UP reaches the socket
with 192.168.90.20/24 set again, the addresses 0.1.2.3, 240.1.2.3 and 224.0.0.1 answer EINVAL
a default route through 192.168.90.1 is taken
a default route through 10.0.2.2, off the subnet, answers ENETUNREACH
a route to 10.10.10.0/24 is added and removed
a default route with no gateway answers EINVAL and keeps the gateway, whose removal then succeeds
a route added or removed for eth9 answers ENODEV
the route to the machine's own subnet is added, and its removal answers EOPNOTSUPP
the default route is removed
a second removal of the default route answers ESRCH
192.168.1.0 is accepted and not in force until the mask 255.255.0.0 makes it a host, and then the mask 255.255.255.0 answers EINVAL
192.168.1.0 set on a machine with no address, refused the mask 255.255.255.0, leaves the machine with no address
10.0.2.15/24 and the default route through 10.0.2.2 are set again, and the gateway answers a ping

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the probe runs on the e1000's driver, changes the machine's address, flags and routes and takes its interface down; tests/native/probes.cases runs the probe's queries natively, and the host sends its datagrams through the forward of QEMU's user network

cases.behavior: netifprobe configures a machine booted with rach2.ip=none on the e1000 from nothing: an address, then a mask, then a default route, after which the gateway answers

steps.does: boot the test image with rach2.ip=none to the debug shell
run netifprobe at the debug shell and take its report from the console

assertions.checks: the raw descriptor that BusyBox's DHCP client asks the interface through, AF_INET, SOCK_RAW and IPPROTO_RAW, opens
a raw socket for TCP, a protocol the stack does not carry, answers EPROTONOSUPPORT
eth0 has index 1, and SIOCGIFINDEX of eth9 answers ENODEV
SIOCGIFNAME of index 1 gives eth0, and of index 7 answers ENODEV
SIOCGIFHWADDR of eth0 gives an Ethernet address that is not all zeros
SIOCGIFADDR of eth0 reads its address
a machine with no address reports the netmask 0
the address 10.0.2.15 is set on the machine that has none
the address set alone takes the classful mask 255.0.0.0
the mask 255.255.255.0 set after it leaves the address as it was
a default route through 10.0.2.2 is set
the gateway answers a ping from the machine configured from nothing

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the probe runs on the e1000's driver, on a machine booted with rach2.ip=none
